name: Wall Buzz for WooCommerce
author: Paper Pixel Studio

sections.description:
Wall Buzz is a plugin for WooCommerce to help artists sell more of their work.

A product photo rarely does a good job of showing shoppers how big a 16×20 piece of art is. Wall Buzz can. It “hangs” your art on a photo of a room at its approximate size, in the sizes you sell. Wall Buzz is convenient for your shoppers. They simply browse the artwork and sizes until they find one they like, then add it to the cart from the same screen. The status bar displays the cost while they browse your work so they’re always informed.

Sizes are close, not exact, since they depend on carefully marking the room for sizing. They’re close enough to show the difference among 5×7, 8×10, 11×14, and 16×20 sizes, for example.

Everything runs in your WooCommerce install. You don’t need any outside services or accounts. Wall Buzz doesn’t limit how many pieces your catalog has either. It works in your shopper’s browser, so server requirements are minimal.

Features

  • Configure rooms for your shoppers to stage your artwork in. Use your photos, or any you have the rights to use for that purpose.

  • Only the sizes you sell are available. That’s determined by the product’s variations, which Wall Buzz draws to scale in the room.

  • You can also sell originals and other single pieces which have no variations.

  • Wall Buzz hides sold-out pieces from the list of artwork available for preview.

  • Because artwork can be sold in different ratios, you can upload a different image for any size. This keeps the preview your shopper sees more accurate.

  • Wall Buzz follows your WooCommerce measurement unit settings (inches or centimeters).

  • Add to cart from the preview so your shopper doesn’t have to backtrack to your product page.

  • Built for computers and phones, with a built-in help system that labels every control.

  • Shoppers can download a picture of the wall labeled with your site URL and details about the artwork. It’s easy for your shoppers to show others if they need to talk it over before buying.

  • All interface text is customizable. Wall Buzz allows you to change any sentence your shoppers read.

  • Can be operated using only the keyboard for people who have difficulty using a mouse.

  • Translation template included.

User guide

Follow the user guide at https://paperpixelstudio.com/wall-buzz/user-guide/ to learn how to add a room, enable Wall Buzz for your products, and make the preview page.

Wall Buzz Gold

Wall Buzz Gold is an optional paid add-on.

  • You can allow shoppers to “hang” your art on their own photo of a wall.

  • Shoppers can lay out gallery walls of up to 20 pieces. Arrangement controls help align and distribute the artwork. Shoppers can then add everything to the cart in one click. The status bar keeps your shoppers informed of how much the whole gallery wall will cost.

  • You can allow signed-in customers to save rooms to come back to later.

  • Wall Buzz adds a link on every product page that opens the preview page with that piece already hanging.

  • Customize main interface colors, checked for contrast.

Customer support: https://www.paperpixelstudio.com/contact/

Wall Buzz and Wall Buzz Gold are trademarks of Paper Pixel Studio. WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc.
sections.installation:
NOTE: Exclude the preview page the Wall Buzz shortcode is on from full-page caching, whether a plugin or your host does it. A cached copy older than 12 hours can’t add to the cart.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.7 or later
  • WooCommerce 10.0 or later
  • PHP 8.2 or later

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is easy. First make sure you have WooCommerce installed, activated, and fully configured. Then, simply log in to your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New Plugin. In the search field, type “Wall Buzz for WooCommerce” and click “Search Plugins”. Once you’ve found it click “Install Now”.

Manual installation

This is a trickier method we don’t recommend. Upload the Wall Buzz for WooCommerce files to wp-content/plugins/wall-buzz-for-woocommerce. Then, go into Plugins → Installed Plugins and click “Activate”.

Updates

We recommend you always back up your site before doing any updates. WordPress offers Wall Buzz for WooCommerce updates like any other plugin.

Uninstall

If you’re temporarily removing Wall Buzz, simply go to Plugins → Installed Plugins, and click “Deactivate” then “Delete”. Wall Buzz will keep your whole configuration. If you want to permanently remove all Wall Buzz data from your site and database, go to WooCommerce → Wall Buzz → Clean-up tab. Make sure the “Remove” box is ticked, click “Save”. Then uninstall following the instructions above.
